Devahuti was so devoted to her husband that she not only served him with great affection, service, and
respect, but also did not care about her health. This
is called selfless service. It seems that she did not get sensual pleasure from her husband,
otherwise her health would not have deteriorated. She was doing that work for the spiritual upliftment of Kardam Muni,
she was constantly helping him, and she did not care about her physical pleasure.
It is the duty of an obedient and virtuous wife to help her husband in every way,
especially when the husband is engaged in Krishna consciousness.
In this example, the husband also properly rewarded his wife.
A normal man's wife never has such hopes.

These are the penances, meditation, and self-control
accomplished by the grace of the Lord, which are not opposed by my service.
They are not opposed by the sight of my service, nor are they saddened by my fear. 7/. Meaning of the word:
Ye- that; Me- by me; Sw- religious life; Niratasya- completely engaged; Qu: — In penance;
Meditation--in meditation; Knowledge--in Krishna's nectar; Self-yoga--by stabilizing the mind; Victory--achieved;
Blessings of God--by God's grace; Tan--to them; Ev--also; Te-by you; Mat-by the lotus; Anushevanaya--by service;
With devotion; Arrested--obtained; Drishti--divine vision; Prapashya-look; Vitarami-yen giving; Abhayan--free from fear;
Ashokan-devoid of sorrow;
Kardam Muni further said- I have obtained the blessings of God while living my religious life of penance, meditation and devotion to Krishna.
Although you are not yet free from fear and sorrow,
I will give you these achievements (divine powers),
because you are engaged in my service. Now that you look at them. I am giving you
divine vision, so that you can see how beautiful they are. Meaning: Devahuti remained only engaged in the service of Kardama Muni. She was not so advanced in penance, meditation, or
Krishna consciousness, but unseen, she was participating in her husband's achievements.
She could neither see nor experience them. All these blessings of God were automatically obtained.
